log.text: The public civil almanac dates 30 Seedwake 1156 AC.
A place is established in the lived world: Thistlebell Yard.

At first bell, Thistlebell Yard is already awake. Barley carts creak along the orchard road; the smell of bruised apples drifts from the presses, and water beads on the harness rails. Ten-year-old Maddoc Maddren is beside the public trough, where an ash-coated burden beast has planted all four feet and refuses to move. Two adult handlers argue in low voices about whether it has been overworked. Neither reaches for the animal. Beyond the yard, canal bells sound for the morning barges.

personality.speechStyle: Expressive and confident, with cheeky humour, playful mischief and quick, sharp comebacks. He is capable of serious, precise explanation, tact and sincere kindness. Age-appropriate for ten; avoid making every line a joke.
interactionPatterns: Playfully needles friends and enjoys banter without wanting to hurt them; he once coaxed Tessa and Bram into debating just to watch them argue.
Advocates for friends with specific evidence and logic, as when he spoke up for Tessa's potential to the instructor after watching her stone skipping.
Encourages others to speak for themselves rather than taking credit or replacing their judgement; he helped Tessa articulate the flaw she already spotted.

Shares discovery and ownership of research: works collaboratively, actively discusses what he reads, takes comprehensive notes, delegates explanation to Bram sometimes, and makes information accessible to Tessa.

Takes initiative without monopolising decisions: considered what Tessa and Bram both wanted to do, backed Tessa's training, and chose to explore Arcane first for Bram even though Soul interests him more.
Interested in power systems, compares foundations and limitations methodically, asks questions and looks beyond the first path presented.
Expressed a strong current interest in Soul Cultivation, but has not committed to a discipline or attained any power.
knowledgeFromPlay: Personally studied introductory Meridian Cultivation with Bram: anatomy, 12 primary and eight extraordinary meridians, branch networks, 108 Gates, three Dantian centres, nine stages, practical foundation cautions and applications.
Personally studied introductory Arcane Circle Architecture with Bram: Mana Core and spell geometry, all nine Circles, design, stability, limits, risks and beast-ability analogues.
Personally studied introductory Soul Cultivation and Engineering with Bram: seven phases, spiritual perception, threading, resonance, higher architecture, legitimate applications, consent and limits.
This is introductory reading and handwritten shared notes, not practised magical ability, expert mastery or a mechanical skill award.
personality.application: Always include the player's meaningful spoken words as Maddoc's dialogue, only correcting minor typing for readability while preserving intent and tone. Narrate Maddoc as a fully participating, knowledgeable character in ongoing scenes; when an already chosen action implies ordinary conversation, generate short incidental replies in his established voice, including relevant things he actually learned, rather than making NPCs do all the talking. Support natural discussion with Bram and Tessa. The player's explicit new dialogue and actions override this profile.
personality.limits: Never invent Maddoc's private feelings, fixed beliefs, promises, major decisions, purchases, consent, earned abilities or consequential actions. Do not choose a cultivation discipline for him. Dialogue should not pretend he knows anything beyond sources actually encountered. Avoid repetitive jokes or overconfident caricature.

focus: Meet Bram and Tessa after household work
chatRuntime.scene: Morning of 1 Nesting 1156 AC, 08:00: Maddoc wakes rested at his family cottage after successful Soul self-awareness practice the previous evening. He meets Hedra beside the homestead shed, where muddy harnesses, buckles and worn straps await sorting and cleaning. Hedra offered 2 Talons for a properly completed morning's work; the job has not yet been performed or paid. Bram and Tessa are to be met later if possible.

journal.text: Maddoc said, 'Is arguing all you can do?' and began putting right the twisted harness. An ash-coated burden beast had a tight metal fitting rubbing its left shoulder raw. He loosened and straightened that strap; the animal remained at the trough and made no commitment to pull the cart. No new bond, injury, material or resources recorded.
After leaving the small seed-eating creature beneath the Rillbend culvert, Maddoc walked 16 minutes to Tansyhook Crossing (08:23). No other outcomes, resource or relationship changes.

Maddoc said 'Just follow me' and led willing companions Tessa and Bram to Mossgate Common. He is looking for books, training, or beast handling. Arrival recorded at 08:44, without rolling or granting access.
Maddoc and Bram complete introductory Meridian theory and handwritten notes at the reading house; time verified 11:04.
At 13:39 Maddoc and Bram completed reading and handwritten introductory notes for Arcane and Soul; no cultivation gain.
After windfall apples, four-hour failed Soul practice and walk home, Maddoc is at home 18:51, stamina 34/36; friends plan tomorrow.
Safe checkpoint before potential mechanics implementation; Maddoc home at 18:51, stamina 34/36, no Soul progress.

After family supper, Maddoc practised Soul self-awareness 129 minutes until 21:00: d20 17+2=19 vs 14, +2 progress (2/100), -2 stamina. Slept 11h; woke 08:00, stamina restored 36/36. Hedra discussed 2 Talons for completed harness-cleaning and sorting work; no work or pay yet.

thistlebell_yard.name: Thistlebell Yard
thistlebell_yard.description: A shared beast-handling yard beside the orchard road, with timber harness rails, a public watering trough, fruit presses and a downhill track toward the grain-barge canal.
thistlebell_yard.culture: Asterwyn vale-country; orchard work, ordinary beast care and grain-barge traffic shape the daily schedule.

rillbend_orchard_path.name: Rillbend Orchard Path
rillbend_orchard_path.description: A narrow public footpath beyond Thistlebell Yard, threading between old apple orchards and a shallow drainage rill. Moss-dark stone culverts carry rainwater beneath the trail; a wooden handrail crosses the lowest bend.
rillbend_orchard_path.culture: Asterwyn Orchard Vales; walkers share the path with farm workers, orchard carts on the nearby road and seasonal beasts passing through hedgerows.

tansyhook_crossing.name: Tansyhook Crossing
tansyhook_crossing.description: A busy meeting of two public orchard lanes at a narrow timber bridge over an irrigation channel. A roofed weighing shed and fruit-cart layby stand beside the lane; the canal road continues downhill past hedge-grown orchards.
tansyhook_crossing.culture: Orchard Vales in the Asterwyn Crown: family orchards, seasonal harvest work, draft-beast caravans and barges use the adjoining country roads.

mossgate_common.name: Mossgate Common
mossgate_common.description: A small orchard hamlet green off the Tansyhook lane. A low slate-roofed reading house stands beside a public well; beyond the green is an enclosed practice yard with sand and training posts, and farther downwind are fenced beast-handling pens with water troughs.
mossgate_common.culture: An ordinary Asterwyn Orchard Vales hamlet serving orchard families, young learners, seasonal workers and licensed animal handlers. Buildings and paddocks are visible from public lanes; access, instruction, and beast welfare remain the responsibility of their actual caretakers.

journeys.describedRoute: Maddoc left Thistlebell Yard through its open gate and followed the ordinary orchard footpath downhill beside the apple rows, reaching the shallow drainage rill and stone culvert without encountering an obstacle.
journeys.means: walking along the public orchard footpath

journeys.describedRoute: Maddoc left the small moss-green feathered seed-eater undisturbed under the Rillbend culvert, climbed back onto the public footpath, and followed the orchard lanes across a quiet, uncomplicated stretch of the Vales to Tansyhook Crossing.

Maddoc led Tessa and Bram along the public orchard lane from Tansyhook Crossing, passing hedgerows, fruit carts and a gently climbing footbridge before reaching the village green of Mossgate Common. The ordinary walk posed no unresolved hazard.
Maddoc parts from Tessa and Bram at the orchard lanes and walks back from Mossgate Common past Tansyhook Crossing and Thistlebell Yard to his family's nearby homestead in the fading evening light.
